list.title: Credit Limit
list.intro: Our credit limit is available to you on a regular basis for your orders with us and may be used to pay by invoice. The limit describes the maximum amount that can be used for your outstanding invoices at any given time. The corresponding amount is released again with each payment.

create.title: Credit Limit
create.intro: You can request a credit limit to pay by invoice. After you are approved, you will have a credit limit available to pay by invoice. Requesting a credit limit from us does not affect your credit rating.

tilta.loadingScreenText: This could take a few seconds please don’t close the window.
tilta.terms-of-condition: Payment by invoice is offered in partnership with Tilta. I confirm that I have read and accept the privacy policy of Tilta

messages.unknown-error: An unknown error has occurred. Please try again. If further issues persist, please contact customer service.
messages.no-existing-b2b-address: Before you can activate payment by invoice, you need to first create a business billing address.
messages.address-does-not-exist: The requested address does not exist.
messages.no-country-can-not-be-changed: The country cannot be updated for this billing address, since you have a linked credit limit for payment by invoice. Please create a new billing address if you need to change the country.

facility.unknown-error: An unknown error occurred while requesting the credit limit. Please contact customer service for assistance.
facility.created-successfully: The credit limit has been created successful.

checkout.facility-exceeded: Your credit limit is fully spent. Please settle any outstanding invoices before placing another order with payment by invoice. If you have any questions or need assistance, our customer service is here to help.
checkout.facility-too-low: Your available credit limit does not cover the total of this order. Please review and adjust your order or choose a different payment method. If you have any questions or require assistance, please contact our customer service.

legalForms.LIMITED_COMPANY: Limited liability company (e.g. GmbH, Ltd., Sp. z o.o.)
legalForms.PUBLIC_COMPANY: Public company (e.g. AG, SE) or corporation

checkout.title: Payment by invoice
checkout.informationAboutDuration: You have %duration days to pay after your order is shipped. We will send you a reminder with all important details when the payment date approaches.

buyerRegistration.intro: To activate your account for payment by invoice, we need a few additional business details. This is a one-time step – you won’t need to resubmit them for future orders.

address.phoneNumberNotice: Please note the correct format of the phone number. It must start with the country code and should not contain any spaces. Example: +491731010101.
